mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended('r61:workspace:' || CAST(#{actor.spaceId} AS text) || ':' || CAST(#{workspaceId} AS text),0))

SELECT CASE WHEN pf.authorize_workspace_actor(#{actor.userId},#{actor.spaceId}) THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.workspace w JOIN pf.space s ON s.id=w.space_id WHERE w.id=#{workspaceId} AND w.space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND w.state='READY' AND s.type='PERSONAL' AND s.owner_user_id=#{actor.userId} FOR SHARE OF w) ELSE false END

SELECT version, default_model_id, default_credential_source, default_plan_enabled, default_approval_mode FROM pf.workspace_configuration WHERE space_id=#{actor.spaceId} AND workspace_id=#{workspaceId}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.model_definition WHERE id=#{modelId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND model_name IN ('deepseek-flash','deepseek-v4-pro'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.workspace_configuration(space_id, workspace_id) VALUES(#{actor.spaceId}, #{workspaceId}) ON CONFLICT(space_id, workspace_id) DO NOTHING
